name: Cold Brew Vanilla Latte
caffeineNote: Label: 160 mg per can, printed on the front
summary: Cold brew vanilla latte on the same oatmilk-and-olive-oil base as Great Lakes’ Mocha, at a label-printed 160 mg of caffeine per 11 fl oz can and 150 calories. All 15 g of its sugar is added, for 1 g of protein and 7 g of fat. Great Lakes’ own site sells it only inside their Latte Variety Pack, mixed with the Mocha and Lavender, so there is no single-flavor price to list.
